meta_description: MTM Electrical Services in Sheffield. Professional electrician for domestic and commercial work. Same-day repairs and installations. Call 07868 230307.
hero_subhead: Electrical fault in Sheffield? We diagnose and repair most issues same day, with no hidden charges.
services_subhead: From emergency repairs and rewiring to new installations and safety testing, we handle all domestic and commercial electrical work.

services.title: Emergency Electrical Repairs
services.desc: Blown fuses, tripped electrics, or dead sockets? We arrive fast and diagnose the fault within the hour. Most repairs completed same day with parts on the van.

services.title: House Rewiring & Updates
services.desc: Old wiring putting your home at risk? Full house rewires bring your electrics up to current Building Regulations, improving safety and adding new circuits where you need them.

services.title: Boiler & Heating Electrics
services.desc: New boiler installation wiring, heating system upgrades, and fault diagnosis. We work with plumbers and heating engineers to ensure seamless installation.

services.title: Lighting Installation & Design
services.desc: New light fittings, LED conversions, spotlights, and exterior security lighting. We design layouts to suit your space and fit to the highest standard.

services.title: Consumer Unit Upgrades
services.desc: Old fuse boxes replaced with modern RCD-protected consumer units. Essential for safety and required by most insurers and mortgage lenders.

services.title: Periodic Testing & Inspections
services.desc: EICR (Electrical Installation Condition Reports) for landlords, home buyers, and businesses. We identify faults early and provide remedial reports.

about_pullquote: I fix electrical problems others can't be bothered with properly.
about_para_1: MTM Electrical Services has been serving Sheffield for over 15 years. Founded on the principle that every job — whether a simple socket replacement or a full house rewire — deserves the same attention to detail and honesty. We hold NICEIC certification and stay current with all Building Regulations changes.
about_para_2: Our reputation is built on turning up on time, explaining what's wrong without jargon, and giving you a fair price. We don't pressure-sell upgrades you don't need, and we're happy to inspect work done by other traders. Most of our work comes from repeat customers and word-of-mouth referrals.
reviews_heading: What Sheffield Customers Say About MTM Electrical

reviews.text: Called them out at 9pm on a Saturday when all our downstairs lights went out. The lad arrived before 10, found a dodgy light switch causing the trip, replaced it and tested everything. Brilliant service, reasonable price, and a nice bloke too. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: David P.

reviews.text: Had MTM round to do a full house rewire. Very professional, kept the mess to a minimum, and explained everything as they went. New consumer unit installed and signed off. Peace of mind knowing the wiring is safe now. Will use them again.
reviews.author: Jennifer M.

reviews.text: They came to inspect electrics for our mortgage survey. Found a couple of non-compliant circuits that the previous surveyor missed. Gave us a proper EICR report and a honest quote for the fix. Didn't rush us, answered all our questions. Great service.
reviews.author: Marcus H.
